issues.title: Round 1 schedule update: Google Form, 9 October deadline, results by 11 October
issues.correction_body:
The organiser has updated the Round 1 research submission route and schedule. This notice supersedes the earlier 11 October research deadline and GitHub research submission instructions.

| Milestone | Date and time (IST) |
|---|---|
| Round 1 research submissions close | 9 October 2026, 23:59 |
| Round 1 results announced by | 11 October 2026, 22:00 |
| Round 2 starts | 12 October 2026 |
| Final build submissions close | 18 October 2026, 23:59 |

Round 1 research submissions will be collected through a **Google Form**. The organiser will release the form link soon through the official Discord server and [the submission guide](https://github.com/RomeoJulietLove/The-Sequential-Matching-Problem/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION.md#research-submission). The form is not yet available. GitHub Issues are not the Round 1 submission route.

Round 2 final build submissions continue to use the Final submission issue form. Its deadline remains unchanged. The PS, README, submission guide and downloadable PDF are being aligned with this notice.
